title.en: Fable 14 — The Farmer and the Snake

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: בחורף קר איכר הלך בשדה שלו.
sentences.en: In a cold winter a farmer walked in his field.

sentences.ar: הוא ראה נחש שוכב על השלג.
sentences.en: He saw a snake lying on the snow.

sentences.ar: הנחש לא זז, והוא היה קפוא.
sentences.en: The snake did not move, and it was frozen.
The farmer stood and looked at it a moment.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הוא ימות כאן בקור.
sentences.en: He said: it will die here in the cold.

sentences.ar: הוא הרים אותו ושם אותו בבגד.
sentences.en: He picked it up and put it in his clothing.
His wife said: why did you bring it?

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הוא קטן, ואין בו סכנה.
sentences.en: He said: it is small, and there is no danger in it.

sentences.ar: הוא שם אותו על יד האש.
sentences.en: He put it beside the fire.
The heat entered the snake’s body.
It began to move slowly slowly.

sentences.ar: אחרי שעה הוא כבר היה חזק.
sentences.en: After an hour it was already strong.
The children came to see it.
The snake raised its head to them.
The farmer jumped and took a stick from the corner.
A kindness to a bad one comes back as harm.
